scope: independent Fractal forecast vs PLC emulator; same PLC snapshot and full physical second per emulator step; first interval shortened to the next absolute PLC hour boundary
note: Ordinal pairing is diagnostic, not proof of event identity if cycle counts differ. Emulator readings are taken at exact absolute PLC hour boundaries; levels, main flow and pressures are TRUE values (not noisy PLC sensor snapshots). Fractal shortens its first interval to the next absolute PLC boundary (e.g. 3570 s from an initial t=30 s), then uses complete 3600 s profile intervals. Both models use the same profile entry up to each comparison boundary. Fractal holds hourly distribution fixed. Fractal recirculation totals are accumulated across hours, no commands applied.
